# Managing Your ElevenLabs Subscription (Mobile App vs. Website)

If you subscribed to ElevenLabs through the mobile app (Apple App Store or Google Play), please note that your subscription is handled entirely by the app store, not ElevenLabs directly. 

If you subscribed through the mobile app, it isn't possible to use Pay As You Go. If you want access to this feature, you'll need to switch to a website subscription. See below for details on how to do this. 

 

<strong>
  Subscriptions Purchased in the App (Apple or Google Play)
</strong>

All billing, renewals, upgrades, and cancellations must be managed through your device’s app store account. ElevenLabs cannot cancel or modify App Store or Google Play subscriptions. 

If you’d like to switch to a website (Stripe) subscription, you must: 

* Cancel your mobile app subscription through the App Store or Google Play.
* Wait until it expires (it will remain active until the end of your current billing period).
* After expiration, visit [elevenlabs.io](https://elevenlabs.io) and subscribe again on the website.

If you attempt to upgrade on the website while your mobile subscription is active, you will see an alert asking you to cancel your mobile subscription first.

 

<strong>
  Subscriptions Purchased on the Website
</strong>

* Website subscriptions are billed through Stripe and can be managed directly from your ElevenLabs account under <strong>Account > Settings > Manage Subscription</strong>
* Website subscriptions can be upgraded, downgraded, or canceled directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

<strong>
  Account Bans or Deletions
</strong>

If your ElevenLabs account is banned or deleted, it does not cancel your App Store or Google Play subscription. You must still cancel it manually through your app store account settings.

 

<strong>
  Useful Links
</strong>

* [Cancel a subscription on the Apple App Store](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039)
* [Cancel a subscription on Google Play](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)<br />

# How do credits work on the ElevenLabs iOS or Android app?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/mobile-apps/eleven-labs-for-ios-and-android/how-do-credits-work-on-the-eleven-labs-ios-or-android-app.md

# How do credits work on the ElevenLabs iOS or Android app?

Credits give you flexibility to power your listening. For Text to Speech, one character will cost you one credit. 

 

<strong>
  Why do we use credits?
</strong>

We believe it’s fair for users as it gives you maximum flexibility. You only get charged credits when you generate content. 

 

<strong>
  How can I get more credits for the ElevenLabs iOS or Android app?
</strong>

Subscribe to our Creator monthly or annual plans for the best savings on credits, or for more options you can login and upgrade at <a href="http://elevenlabs.io">elevenlabs.io</a>. You can use your subscription across our website, iOS and Android apps. 

If you subscribed through the mobile app, it isn't possible to purchase Pay As You Go credits. If you want access to this feature, you'll need to switch to a website subscription. For more information on how to manage your subscription in the app, see [Managing Your ElevenLabs Subscription (Mobile App vs. Website)](/docs/help-center/product/mobile-apps/eleven-labs-for-ios-and-android/managing-your-eleven-labs-subscription-mobile-app-vs-website)

 

<strong>
  When do credits expire in the ElevenLabs iOS or Android app?
</strong>

If you have a subscription, you will automatically rollover unused credits up to twice your usual monthly quota, provided you remain on the same subscription. If you cancel or downgrade your subscription, you will lose any unused credits when that takes effect at the end of your billing cycle.

# How do I complete my W-8/W-9 certification?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/how-do-i-complete-my-w-8-w-9-certification.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do I complete my W-8/W-9 certification?

The W-8/W-9 certification will be requested when your first payout is processed. At this point, you will be notified that you need to complete the certification before you can receive your payouts.

To do this, click <strong>My Account</strong> and select <strong>Payouts</strong> to go to your Payouts page. Then click <strong>Manage Account.</strong>

You will see a section for W-8/W-9 certification, which will be marked <strong>Incomplete</strong>. Click <strong>Update</strong> to open the form<br />

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/34305807020817" alt="" />

Answer the questions on screen. The first question, "Are you considered a U.S. person for Federal Tax Purpose?", will determine whether you complete Form W-9 or Form W-8.

 

<strong>
  Are you considered a U.S. person for Federal Tax Purpose?
</strong>

If yes, you will be prompted to complete Form W-9:

If you have not already done so, enter your SSN.

Certify the statement is accurate by signing.

Click <strong>Submit.</strong>

Click <strong>Confirm</strong> after you have reviewed your details.

If no, you will be prompted to complete Form W-8:

If you are connecting a business account, it will ask you for your tax classification. Select the appropriate classification from the drop-down menu.

Enter your country of citizenship.

Enter your non-U.S. Permanent residence address.

Enter your mailing address if its different from your permanent residence address.

Enter your U.S. Taxpayer ID if you have one.

Enter your non-U.S. Taxpayer Identification number if you have one. This will be the Tax ID for your country of residence. 

Check the box if non-U.S. Taxpayer Identification number not legally required, for example, if your country does not issue Tax IDs.

<strong>Tax Treaty Claims</strong> - if you would like to claim reduced rate of withholding tax, complete this section. This will allow Eleven Labs to apply a lower rate or 0% rate (depending on your country of residence) on the payments it remits to you. 

Are you claiming a reduced rate of withholding under a tax treaty? 

Select <strong>Yes</strong> to claim treaty benefits or <strong>No</strong> if you do not want to claim reduced rate of withholding. 

Type of income: select <strong>Royalties - Copyrights.</strong>

Country of residence: select from the drop-down menu.

Select the tax treaty article listed in the drop-down menu.

Certify that you do not have a permanent establishment or fixed base in the U.S. (i.e. a tax presence).

Select the rate that appears in the drop-down menu - this is configured based on your country of tax residence and the tax treaty it has with the U.S.

Read through and agree to the certification by checking the box and typing your name in the signature field.

Click <strong>Submit</strong> to submit your form.

# What is W-8/W-9 certification?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/what-is-w-8-w-9-certification.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What is W-8/W-9 certification?

<strong>
  Why do I have to complete this form?
</strong>

ElevenLabs is required by U.S. tax law to collect W-8/W-9 certification from anyone who receives payments from us. If you're a U.S. tax resident, you're required to submit W-9 certification. If you're not a U.S. tax resident, you're required to submit W-8 certification.

W-8/W-9 certification helps determine whether a reduced rate of tax withholding under a tax treaty applies to your payments.

 

<strong>
  How do I complete the form?
</strong>

The form is processed via Stripe, which walks you through the steps. We also have a detailed guide available [here](/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/how-do-i-complete-my-w-8-w-9-certification).

 

<strong>
  Why are you withholding tax on payments to me?
</strong>

By default, the U.S. requires a 30% withholding tax on certain types of payments to non-U.S. persons — including royalties. However, if your country has a tax treaty with the U.S., you may be eligible for a reduced withholding rate, which you can claim on the W-8 form. If you do not claim a treaty benefit, the 30% default rate applies.

We will withhold U.S. taxes on earnings from U.S. customer usage only (not your entire payout). Earnings from non-U.S. customer usage will not be included in withholdings.

Your payout dashboard will now include a column showing tax withheld for each past payout.

 

<strong>
  What will I receive from you?
</strong>

Each year, we will issue a <strong>Form 1042-S</strong> showing the total amount we paid you and any U.S. tax we withheld. This form is sent by <strong>March 15 of the following calendar year</strong> and can be used when filing a U.S. tax return, if needed.

 

<strong>
  I already pay taxes in my own country why should I also pay U.S. tax?
</strong>

Because the income you're earning is <strong>U.S.-sourced</strong> (we are a U.S.-based company), we’re required to apply U.S. tax rules. You may still be able to <strong>claim a credit or deduction</strong> in your own country for the tax paid to the U.S., depending on your local laws.

 

<strong>
  Can I skip the form if I don’t live in the U.S?
</strong>

No — if you're receiving payments from us and you're not a U.S. tax resident, we are still required to collect this form to properly apply U.S. tax rules. If we don’t receive a completed W-8, we may not be able to pay you or may have to apply maximum withholding (30%).

 

<strong>
  How do I know if my country has a tax treaty with the U.S.?
</strong>

Stripe may also help you identify treaty eligibility as you complete the form, but you are responsible for verifying that you meet the conditions via the IRS website or a tax professional. 

 

<strong>
  What happens if I don’t complete the form?
</strong>

If you don’t submit a completed W-8 form, we may be required to withhold the full 30% of your earnings from US customer usage until the form is received.

# Where do my payouts come from, and will they show as domestic or international on my bank statement?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/where-do-my-payouts-come-from-and-will-they-show-as-domestic-or-international-on-my-bank-statement.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Where do my payouts come from, and will they show as domestic or international on my bank statement?

Payouts are issued from the country of your Stripe connected account. If your external bank account is in the same country and currency, the payout typically appears as a domestic transfer. If your bank is in a different country or you’re paid in a different currency (for example, via alternative currency payouts), it may appear as an international transfer.

To gauge what to expect, compare the connected account’s country and currency with your external bank account’s country and currency—when they match, expect domestic; when they don’t, expect international.

# Can I add users to my account?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/workspaces/can-i-add-users-to-my-account.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Can I add users to my account?

Yes, every ElevenLabs workspace can have multiple members. Workspaces use a seat-based model. Every member in a workspace occupies one seat, and the seat type they hold determines what they can access and how credits are consumed.

The number and type of seat depends on your subscription:

| Plan              | Included Full Seats | Included Basic Seats |
| ----------------- | ------------------- | -------------------- |
| Free              | 1                   | 20                   |
| PAYG              | 1                   | 20                   |
| Starter           | 1                   | 20                   |
| Creator           | 1                   | 20                   |
| Pro               | 1                   | 20                   |
| Scale             | 3                   | 20                   |
| Business          | 10                  | 20                   |
| Business (Legacy) | 5                   | 20                   |
| Enterprise        | 11 (negotiable)     | 1,000                |

Full Seats provide unrestricted access to all ElevenLabs products and features within a workspace, while Basic Seats have unlimited access to ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI, and limited access to ElevenCreative, up to 50,000 credits each month (\$5 for Enterprise customers).  

Every user in a workspace draws from the same shared credit pool — Basic Seat users do not receive their own credit allocation. The 50,000 credit figure is a per-user ceiling on how much of that shared pool each Basic Seat user can consume through ElevenCreative in a billing period. It is not additional capacity added on top of your plan.

# How do Basic Seat credit limits work?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/workspaces/how-do-basic-seat-credit-limits-work.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do Basic Seat credit limits work?

All workspace members share a single credit pool. Basic Seats do not receive separate credits.

Instead, Basic Seats have a credit ceiling:

* ElevenCreative usage is limited to 50,000 credits per user, per billing cycle
* This limit is drawn from the shared workspace pool
* ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI usage is not capped per user

If the shared credit pool runs out, all generation stops, regardless of individual limits.

If a Basic Seat user reaches their 50,000 credit ceiling, they cannot generate more ElevenCreative content until the next billing cycle. Their access to ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI remains unchanged.

# What are Voice Actor Payouts?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/what-are-voice-actor-payouts.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What are Voice Actor Payouts?

Voice Actor Payouts let you earn cash rewards when paid users generate audio with your Professional Voice Clone shared in the Voice Library. Earnings are calculated based on usage by paid users and exclude use by free users. Your default rate is determined by your selected notice period, and payouts are processed automatically through Stripe.

* To get started, create a <strong>Professional Voice Clone</strong> of your voice. This feature is available on the Creator plan and above. We recommend uploading around 2 hours of clear, high-quality recordings containing only your voice, with consistent tone and no background noise, music, or effects. For detailed guidance, see our [Professional Voice Cloning guide](/docs/product-guides/voices/voice-cloning).
* After uploading your samples, you’ll complete a Voice Captcha verification by reading a short text prompt within a set timeframe. Once verified, your voice will be added to the training queue. The process typically takes a few hours but may take longer at peak times.
* Once training is complete, you can [share your voice in the Voice Library.](/docs/product-guides/voices/voice-library#how-to-share-a-voice-model-in-the-voice-library) After a brief review by our team, your voice will become visible to other users who can save and use it to generate audio.
* You can choose how long your voice remains available after you decide to withdraw it by setting a <strong>notice period</strong>. This ranges from immediate removal up to a two-year period. This flexibility lets you balance earning potential with personal preference while giving other users clarity on when they’ll need to transition away from your voice.
* You can enable <strong>live moderation</strong> for your voice to prevent it from being used in restricted or sensitive content categories.
* Your default payout rate is determined by the notice period you select for your voice.
* To receive payments, you’ll need to set up a <strong>Stripe Connect</strong> account and maintain an active paid subscription (Starter plan or above). Payouts are processed automatically every 6–8 days once your earnings exceed the minimum threshold. In most cases, the threshold is \$10, though some countries may have higher limits due to local regulations or payment provider requirements.

For more information, refer to our [Terms of Service](https://elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use) and [Voice Library Addendum](https://elevenlabs.io/vla).

# Why are Payouts not enabled for my account?

# Why are Payouts not enabled for my account?

There are a couple of possible reasons why Payouts are not enabled for your account.

 

<strong>
  You have not completed the process of setting up your Payout account
</strong>

Payouts won't be enabled for your account until you have completed the process of setting up your Payout account, including agreeing to the Terms.

To complete the process, please visit your Payouts page, and click <strong>Complete Account Setup</strong>, and follow the steps. 

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/34304674986001" alt="" />

If you still see <strong>Complete Account Setup</strong> after completing all the steps, please contact Support by emailing [team@elevenlabs.io](mailto:team@elevenlabs.io).

 

<strong>
  You have not completed your W-8/W-9 certification
</strong>

ElevenLabs is required by U.S. tax law to collect W-8/W-9 certification from anyone who receives payments from us and is not a U.S. tax resident. For more information on this, please see our article <a href="/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/payouts/what-is-w-8-w-9-certification">What is W-8/W-9 certification?</a>

Payouts will be disabled for any user who does not have a valid tax form. To resume Payouts, please visit your Payouts page and click <strong>Manage Account</strong>.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/34304508889105" alt="" />

You will then see <strong>Missing W-8/W-9 certification</strong>. To complete your certification, click <strong>Update</strong> and answer the questions in the form.

# What are Basic Seats?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/workspaces/what-are-basic-seats.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What are Basic Seats?

Basic Seats are designed for workspace members who primarily use ElevenLabs Agents or the ElevenAPI, with limited access to ElevenCreative. 

Basic Seat users have access to core functionality, and limited access to ElevenCreative.

They can:

* Use ElevenAgents with no individual usage ceiling
* Use ElevenAPI with no individual usage ceiling
* View all shared workspace assets, including voices, projects, files, and agents
* Generate ElevenCreative content, up to a 50,000 credit monthly limit. or \$5 for Enterprise customers

Even after reaching the ElevenCreative limit, users retain full access to browse assets and continue using ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

# How do creators earn money on Music Marketplace?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/how-do-creators-earn-money-on-music-marketplace.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do creators earn money on Music Marketplace?

When a song is published, it becomes available in the Eleven Music Marketplace. Each time a user purchases a song, the creator earns a portion of the purchase amount, which is accumulated as a reward in their account.

Creators can see how many times each song has been purchased, along with their total earnings across all published songs. Earnings start at 25% of the purchase price and will increase for active users over time. Applicable fees and taxes may be withheld.

Payouts are processed through the existing ElevenLabs payout system. You can learn more about it <a href="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/en-us/sections/24489825613713-Payouts">here</a>.

When publishing, the following rules apply:

* Maximum of five tracks can be uploaded per day
* Only one variation from each track can be published at a time
* Publishing a different variation of an existing track removes the previously published variation

# What am I purchasing on Music Marketplace?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/what-am-i-purchasing-on-music-marketplace.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What am I purchasing on Music Marketplace?

When you purchase a track on Eleven Music Marketplace, you’re buying a <strong>license</strong>, subject to the <a href="http://elevenlabs.io/mma">Music Marketplace Addendum</a>, based on the <a href="/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/what-usage-types-exist-in-music-marketplace">usage type</a> you select. This license defines where and how the music can be used.

After purchasing, you can <strong>download and remix the track an unlimited number of times</strong> while your paid ElevenLabs subscription is active.

If your subscription ends, you may continue using any music you’ve already purchased under the respective usage type. However, you won’t be able to create new remixes or downloads without an active ElevenLabs subscription.

Any derivative work (i.e., remixes) remain subject to the same usage type and licensing restrictions as the original track.

# What usage types exist in Music Marketplace?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/what-usage-types-exist-in-music-marketplace.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What usage types exist in Music Marketplace?

When purchasing a song on Eleven Music Marketplace, you select a <strong>usage type</strong>.

The selected usage type determines the <strong>license you are purchasing</strong> that defines how you can use the song and any derivative works (such as remixes).

### Social Media License

This license is intended for <strong>individual creators and personal content</strong> published on your own channels, including:

* Social media platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X)
* Monetized videos
* Podcasts
* Personal websites and portfolios

### Paid Marketing License

This license is designed for <strong>business and commercial use</strong>. It includes everything in the <strong>Social Media License</strong>, and also allows use in:

* Paid ads and digital marketing
* Client, freelance, or agency projects
* Commercial products and brand content

### Offline License

This license includes everything in the <strong>Paid Marketing License</strong>, and also allows use in:

* Live events and performances
* Trade shows and conferences
* Physical venues and installations
* In-store or on-location playback

### Enterprise License

This license is available exclusively to customers on the Enterprise plan. It allows the use of songs purchased from the Music Marketplace in accordance with the terms of your ElevenLabs Music Enterprise license, subject to the Forbidden Usage Types of Music Marketplace, defined below.

### Forbidden Usage Types

The following uses are not permitted under any license:

* Distribution to music streaming platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, etc.)
* Redistributing, reselling, sublicensing, or claiming ownership of the music<br />

# What is Eleven Music Marketplace?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/what-is-eleven-music-marketplace.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What is Eleven Music Marketplace?

Eleven Music Marketplace is a library of AI-generated songs created by ElevenLabs users and available for licensing across different usage types. Creators can publish songs generated with ElevenLabs, and other users can purchase usage rights to use, remix, and download those songs for their own projects.

When a song is purchased, the buyer receives a license based on the selected <a href="/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/what-usage-types-exist-in-music-marketplace">usage type</a>, and the <a href="/docs/help-center/product/monetization-business/music-marketplace/how-do-creators-earn-money-on-music-marketplace">creator receives</a> a portion of the payment as a payout.

Eleven Music Marketplace is designed to make discovering, licensing, remixing, and using music simple and straightforward.

# Saturday Sessions

## <strong>General</strong>

<strong>
  What is Saturday Session?
</strong>

On Saturday, April 11, 2026, every audio and music generation in ElevenCreative costs 11x fewer credits. The promotion runs for 24 hours, from 00:00 to 23:59 UTC.

<strong>
  Who is eligible?
</strong>

Everyone on ElevenCreative across all self-serve plans: Free, Starter, Creator, Pro, Scale, and Business. Enterprise plans are not included.

<strong>
  What time does it start and end in my time zone?
</strong>

The promotion runs from 00:00 to 23:59 UTC on April 11. Conversions:

Pacific Time: 5:00 PM Friday, April 10 to 4:59 PM Saturday, April 11

Eastern Time: 8:00 PM Friday, April 10 to 7:59 PM Saturday, April 11

BST (London): 1:00 AM Saturday, April 11 to 12:59 AM Sunday, April 12

CEST (Berlin): 2:00 AM Saturday, April 11 to 1:59 AM Sunday, April 12

IST (India): 5:30 AM Saturday, April 11 to 5:29 AM Sunday, April 12

JST (Tokyo): 9:00 AM Saturday, April 11 to 8:59 AM Sunday, April 12

AEST (Sydney): 10:00 AM Saturday, April 11 to 9:59 AM Sunday, April 12

## <strong>What’s Included</strong>

<strong>
  Which products are included?
</strong>

Text to Speech, Studio, Music, Sound Effects, Audiobooks, and Voice generation. These are all ElevenLabs-owned audio models.

<strong>
  Is Image & Video generation included?
</strong>

No. This Saturday Session applies to audio and music models only. Image and video generation is not included in this promotion.

<strong>
  Do I need to opt in or enter a code?
</strong>

No. The reduced pricing applies automatically for everyone on ElevenCreative during the 24-hour window on April 11.

## <strong>Pricing & Credits</strong>

<strong>
  How does the 11x work exactly?
</strong>

Every eligible generation costs 11x fewer credits than it normally would. If a generation normally costs 110 credits, it will cost 10 credits on April 11. The discount is applied at the point of generation.

<strong>
  Does this apply to my existing credits or do I get bonus credits?
</strong>

This applies to your existing credit balance. You are not receiving additional credits. Each generation simply costs less on April 11. Your credits go further.

# Website problems with Safari, iOS (iPhone), macOS (Mac)

We have had reports of iOS, macOS, and especially Safari users occasional experience difficulties when accessing the websites and using our services. These issues appear to be more prevalent in older versions of these platforms. If you are experiencing any difficulties, we recommend trying an alternative browser and checking if that solves the problem.

# When using the website, why am I getting a client-side error?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/website/when-using-the-website-why-am-i-getting-a-client-side-error.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# When using the website, why am I getting a client-side error?

A client-side error typically points to issues within your browser or the cached data and cookies related to our website. It can often be resolved by clearing the browser cache.

Sometimes, the use of browser-based translation tools like Google Translate can unfortunately trigger these errors. This issue stems from some of the components that we use, and it's a known issue across most websites that use these components. We are working on finding a solution.

While we work on a solution, you can still use the website by temporarily pausing the translation feature. If you encounter a message regarding client-side errors after using the “Generate” feature in Speech Synthesis, rest assured that your audio should have been successfully generated and will be available in your History.

If you see a client side error message and you are not using translation in your browser, please try to resolve the issue by clicking “Try again”. If the issue persists, it can usually be resolved by clearing the cache for the website by pressing CTRL + F5. If this does not resolve the issue, please contact Support by emailing us at [team@elevenlabs.io](mailto:team@elevenlabs.io).

# Why is the website refreshing and logging me out?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/website/why-is-the-website-refreshing-and-logging-me-out.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Why is the website refreshing and logging me out?

When you have more than one ElevenLabs tab open in a single browser, the website will attempt to sync across all tabs.  This can result in the website refreshing, or logging the user out. 

We recommend having only one ElevenLabs tab open at a time.

# Can I access the files I generated in the past?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/website/can-i-access-the-files-i-generated-in-the-past.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Can I access the files I generated in the past?

Yes, previously generated files can be downloaded from your history. To access this, first make sure you're logged into your account.

#### <strong>How to download files generated using Text to Speech</strong>

Select <strong>Text to Speech</strong> in the sidebar, then access your history by clicking the history tab in the panel on the right side of the screen. On narrow screens, you can access your history by clicking the history icon above the <strong>Generate speech</strong> button.

From your history, you can click the download icon to see the option to download as either an MP3 or WAV file. For more format options, including M4A and FLAC, click <strong>Advanced</strong>.

#### <strong>How to download files generated using Voice Changer</strong>

Select <strong>Voice Changer</strong> in the sidebar, then access your history by clicking the history tab in the panel on the right side of the screen. On narrow screens, you can access your history by clicking the history icon above the <strong>Generate speech</strong> button.

You can click the download icon to download any file from your history as either an MP3 or WAV file. For more format options, including M4A and FLAC, click <strong>Advanced</strong>.

# API - Error Code 400 or 401

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/api-error-code-400-or-401.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# API - Error Code 400 or 401

These error codes can have a number of causes.  The response message will indicate the cause of the error.

###  

### max\_character\_limit\_exceeded

The maximum number of characters per request depends on the model.

* Flash v2.5 - up to 40,000 characters (\~40 minutes of audio)
* Turbo v2.5 - up to 40,000 characters (\~40 minutes of audio)
* Flash v2 - up to 30,000 characters (\~30 minutes of audio)
* Turbo v2 - up to 30,000 characters (\~30 minutes of audio)
* Multilingual v1 and v2 - up to 10,000 characters (\~10 minutes of audio)
* English v1 and v2 - up to 10,000 characters (\~10 minutes of audio)

###  

### invalid\_api\_key

This means that you have not set your API key correctly.  Please make sure you're using "xi-api-key" exactly, with no typos, when setting your API key. 

###  

### voice\_not\_found

This means that you have entered the incorrect voice\_id.  Please check that you are using the correct voice\_id for the voice you want to use.  You can check this in My Voices.

###  

### quota\_exceeded

You have insufficient quota to complete the request.  You can purchase [Pay As You Go credits](/docs/overview/administration/pay-as-you-go), or on legacy Creator, Pro, Scale and Business plans, you can enable [usage based billing](/docs/help-center/account/general/what-is-usage-based-billing) from your [Subscription](https://elevenlabs.io/app/subscription) page.

 

Example 400 response detail:

`"detail": &#123;
 "status": "max_character_limit_exceeded",
 "message": "This request's text has 627 characters and exceeds the character limit of 333 characters for non signed in accounts."
&#125;`

Example 401 response detail:

`"detail": &#123;
 "status": "invalid_api_key",
 "message": "Invalid API key"
&#125;`

# API - Error Code 422

# API - Error Code 422

### value\_error: Required value is not provided or is not in the correct format

> Check [https://api.elevenlabs.io/docs#/](https://api.elevenlabs.io/docs#/) to see what parameters are required for the endpoint you are using. Ensure you are setting it properly.

### cors error

> A code 422 of type “cors” most commonly seems to occur when you do not use JSON.stringify() on the request body when using fetch() in JavaScript. It might also occur if you call one of the API from a frontend.

With any unsuccessful API response, be sure to check the response body as it will contain error detail in json format.

# API - Error Code 429

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/api-error-code-429.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# API - Error Code 429

API Error Code 429 can have two response messages: `too_many_concurrent_requests` or `system_busy`.

### too\_many\_concurrent\_requests

If you see the response message `too_many_concurrent_requests`, this means that you have exceeded the concurrency limit for your subscription.  

The concurrency limit (concurrent requests running in parallel) depends on the plan you are on. Below are the current rates for each plan, but please note that we will likely revisit them in the future.

> Free: 2<br />Starter: 3<br />Creator: 5<br />Pro: 10<br />Scale: 15<br />Business: 15

ElevenAgents has different concurrency limits. For details, please see [this article.](/docs/help-center/product/conversational-agents/eleven-labs-agents-formerly-conversational-ai/how-many-eleven-agents-requests-can-i-make-and-can-i-increase-it)

### system\_busy

If you see the response message `system_busy`, this means that our services were experiencing high levels of traffic and your request could not be processed.  Generally, if you retry the request, it will succeed.

# Do pauses and SSML phoneme tags work with the API?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/do-pauses-and-ssml-phoneme-tags-work-with-the-api.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Do pauses and SSML phoneme tags work with the API?

<strong>
  Pauses:
</strong>

You can use the break tag when generating audio via the API. This will create an exact and natural pause in the speech. It is not just added silence between words, but the AI has an actual understanding of this syntax and will add a natural pause.

The syntax for the break tag is `<break time="1.5s" />` and the AI can handle pauses of up to 3 seconds in length.  

All of our models, <strong>with the exception of Eleven V3</strong>, support SSML break tags, and these can be used when generating audio via the API.

If you are using <strong>Eleven V3</strong>, you can instead incorporate expressive pause tags such as <strong>\[pause]</strong>, <strong>\[short pause]</strong>, and <strong>\[long pause]</strong>. These tags are exclusive to Eleven V3 and are not supported by other models.

For more information, please see the [Pause](/docs/overview/capabilities/text-to-speech/best-practices#pauses) section of our [guide to Prompting.](/docs/overview/capabilities/text-to-speech/best-practices)<br /><br /><strong>Phonemes:</strong>

Our <strong>Eleven English V1</strong>, <strong>Eleven Flash V2</strong>, and <strong>Eleven Turbo V2</strong> models support <strong>SSML phoneme tags</strong>, and these can be used when generating audio via the API using these models. 

Please note that phonemes are available only for English language models and are currently not supported for other languages.

For full details on how to use phoneme tags, please see the [Pronunciation](/docs/overview/capabilities/text-to-speech/best-practices#pronunciation) section of our guide to Prompting.

# How can I keep the WebSocket open?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/how-can-i-keep-the-websocket-open.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How can I keep the WebSocket open?

If you're working with the text-to-speech WebSockets endpoint via our API, the connection will automatically close after 20 seconds of inactivity.

To keep the connection open, you can send a single space character " ". Please note that this string must include a space, as sending a fully empty string, "", will send an End of Sequence (EOS) message, closing the socket.

This will keep the connection open for another 20 seconds.  To keep the connection open for longer, you will need to send additional single space characters " " every 20 seconds.  

You can also specify how long the connection can be inactive before it's automatically closed.  The default value is 20 seconds, but you can change this by adding `inactivity_timeout` as a query parameter in the WebSockets endpoint.  The maximum allowed value is 180 seconds.

For more information, please see the [WebSockets API Reference.](/docs/api-reference/websockets)

# How do I authorize myself using an API key?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/how-do-i-authorize-myself-using-an-api-key.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do I authorize myself using an API key?

In order to use our API you need to create your an API key first. [Create an account](https://elevenlabs.io/app/sign-up) and log in, click <strong>Developers</strong> in the left sidebar, then select the <strong>API Keys</strong> tab. 

You can create multiple API keys, and each key will have its own name for identification purposes. 

You will only be able to see your API key in full when you first create it. After it has been created, you will only be able to see the name and final four characters. The full key will no longer be available to view.  

By default, your API key will be restricted, and you will need to select the features you would like to enable access for. You can also set optional credit limits for each API key.

You can turn off all restrictions using the <strong>Restrict Key</strong> toggle, but for security reasons, we recommend implementing restrictions on your API key.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/38544727512465" alt="" />

To edit an existing API key, click the <strong>More Actions</strong> (...) icon to the right of the key in the list of API key, then select <strong>Edit.</strong> 

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/38544702228497" alt="" />

To delete an existing API key, click the <strong>More Actions</strong> icon to the right of the key in the list of API key, then select <strong>Delete.</strong> Deleting an API key is irreversible.

Do not show your API keys to anyone else. If someone gains access to one of your API keys, they can use your account as if they knew your password.

# How can I see information about API requests for my account?

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How can I see information about API requests for my account?

You can access information about API requests for your account in Usage Analytics, under the API Requests section.

There are two tabs in Usage Analytics. The Account tab shows data for your individual account, whereas the Workspace tab covers all accounts under your Workspace. If you’re not in a multi-seat Workspace, the data will be the same across the two tabs.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/32811193768465" alt="" />

In the API Requests section, you’ll find not only the total number of requests made within a specific timeframe but also the number of concurrent requests during that period.

You can view data by different time periods, for example, hour, day, month and year, and at different levels of granularity.

# How do I find the voice ID of my voices via the website and API?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/how-do-i-find-the-voice-id-of-my-voices-via-the-website-and-api.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do I find the voice ID of my voices via the website and API?

The easiest way to obtain the voice ID of individual voices is to find it in [My Voices](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-lab), click <strong>More actions</strong> (three dots) then <strong>Copy voice ID</strong>. This copies the voice ID to your clipboard.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/37145694306321" alt="" />

You can also use the [List Voices API endpoint](/docs/api-reference/voices/search) to return a list of all available voices for a user.

For more information on how to use our API, see our [documentation](/docs/api-reference/introduction).

# How many Text to Speech requests can I make and can I increase it?

# How many Text to Speech requests can I make and can I increase it?

The concurrency limit (concurrent requests running in parallel) depends on the tier you are on. 

Below are the current concurrency rates for Text to Speech.

| Plan     | Flash and Turbo models | All other models |
| -------- | ---------------------- | ---------------- |
| Free     | 4                      | 2                |
| Starter  | 6                      | 3                |
| Creator  | 10                     | 5                |
| Pro      | 20                     | 10               |
| Scale    | 30                     | 15               |
| Business | 30                     | 15               |

 

If you require a higher number of concurrent requests, please reach out to our Enterprise Department directly via [this webpage](https://elevenlabs.io/enterprise). We will be happy to discuss a tailor-made plan that meets your specific requirements.

ElevenAgents and Speech to Text have different concurrency limits:

* [ElevenAgents concurrency limits.](/docs/help-center/product/conversational-agents/eleven-labs-agents-formerly-conversational-ai/how-many-eleven-agents-requests-can-i-make-and-can-i-increase-it)
* [Speech to Text concurrency limits.](/docs/help-center/product/speech-synthesis/speech-to-text/how-many-speech-to-text-requests-can-i-make-and-can-i-increase-it)

# What is the Text-to-Speech WebSockets API?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/what-is-the-text-to-speech-web-sockets-api.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What is the Text-to-Speech WebSockets API?

The WebSocket streaming endpoint, also sometimes referred to as input streaming, provides real-time [text-to-speech](https://elevenlabs.io/text-to-speech) conversion using WebSockets. This allows you to send a text message and receive audio data back in real-time.

It is designed to start generating audio chunks from just partial text chunks as input. It can help minimize latency by starting to generate the output before the whole context is delivered and is supposed to be used in conjunction with other tools such as Large Language Models (LLMs). The generated audio will still sound like a string of continuous speech.

Although highly flexible, the WebSockets API isn’t a one-size-fits-all solution.

It’s well-suited for scenarios where:

* The input text is being streamed or generated in chunks.
* The lowest possible latency is needed.
* Word-to-audio alignment information is required.

 It may not be the best choice when:

* The entire input text is delivered at once. Given that the generations are partial, some buffering is involved, which could potentially result in slightly higher latency compared to a standard HTTP request. Instead, using only the output streaming endpoint is most likely the better option in cases like this.
* You want to quickly experiment or prototype. Working with WebSockets can be harder and more complex than using a standard HTTP API, which might slow down rapid development and testing.
* Where the highest possible consistency is of utmost importance, you need to consider the AI's context understanding. Since the AI is not given the full context at the beginning of the request, it will only have a partial understanding of the text, which in certain instances can cause issues. However, you can experiment with some of the settings available when using WebSocket streaming, such as the "chunk\_length\_schedule". This parameter will determine how big the chunks need to be before the AI starts generating text.

In these cases, use the [Text to Speech API](/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech) instead.

To find out more, please see the [WebSockets API Reference.](/docs/api-reference/websockets)

# Why does my voice sound different in the API compared to the website?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/technical/why-does-my-voice-sound-different-in-the-api-compared-to-the-website.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Why does my voice sound different in the API compared to the website?

One possible reason is that different models were used to generate the audio.  If you didn't set a model to use in your API call, it will use the default model which is Multilingual v2 - `eleven_multilingual_v2`.  You can see a list with details of all our models and their ids in our Help Center article, [What models do you offer and what is the difference between them?](/docs/help-center/technical/what-models-do-you-offer-and-what-is-the-difference-between-them)

Another potential cause is voice settings.  Due to the nature of generative AI, there will always be slight differences between different generations, and the same input will generate different results each time, but some voice settings will have an impact on how varied your outputs will be. For example, low stability and low similarity can result in higher than usual variation between generations. You can find out more in our [guide to Voice Settings.](/docs/product-guides/playground/text-to-speech#settings)

# Can I publish the content I generate on the platform?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/can-i-publish-the-content-i-generate-on-the-platform.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Can I publish the content I generate on the platform?

The free plan does <strong>not</strong> include a commercial license and cannot be used for any commercial purpose. If you publish content generated using our Services on a free plan or without being signed-in to your account, you must attribute it to ElevenLabs by including "elevenlabs.io" or "11.ai" in the title (except in the case where your content is generated using Eleven Music on a free plan or without being signed-in to your account, you must attribute it to ElevenLabs by referencing "Eleven Music" when distributing such content).

All paid plans include a commercial license, provided you're not using Beta Services. As long as you hold the necessary intellectual property rights to your generated content, and it complies with applicable laws, our [Terms of Service](https://elevenlabs.io/terms) and [Prohibited Use Policy](https://elevenlabs.io/use-policy), you may use it commercially. Attribution requirement is subject to the agreement you have with ElevenLabs. For full details, refer to our [Terms of Service](https://elevenlabs.io/terms).

In summary:

* Content generated during a paid subscription can be used commercially, and indefinitely. Attribution requirement is subject to the agreement you have with ElevenLabs.
* Content created outside of a paid subscription (before or after) cannot be used commercially and always requires attribution when shared non-commercially.
* Under our [Beta Services Addendum](https://elevenlabs.io/bsa), content generated using Beta Services cannot be used for any commercial purpose or in any production environment.

# Do you restrict access to the service and platform for any specific countries?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/do-you-restrict-access-to-the-service-and-platform-for-any-specific-countries.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Do you restrict access to the service and platform for any specific countries?

We are required to restrict access from the following countries:

* Belarus
* Cuba
* Iran
* North Korea
* Russia
* Syria
* Crimea, and the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts of Ukraine

If you are connecting from one of these sanctioned countries, your access to our service will be blocked.

Some servers may be impacted by this block even if they are not physically located in one of the affected regions, as our cloud provider might flag them as associated with one of these countries. We recommend obtaining a new IP address if possible.

If you believe you have been incorrectly blocked, please email us at [team@elevenlabs.io](mailto:team@elevenlabs.io).

# How do I make a Data Subject Request?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/how-do-i-make-a-data-subject-request.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do I make a Data Subject Request?

To access your data, you can log in to your account on [ElevenLabs.io](https://elevenlabs.io/) and navigate to the History tab to find all of your generated data.

To correct, edit, or delete specific data, where applicable, you can do so directly on the platform.

To delete your account, you can do so via the platform by following the steps in this guide: [How can I delete my account?](/docs/help-center/account/general/how-can-i-delete-my-account)

To open a formal Data Subject Request, please use the following link. This is the only official way to open such a request: [Submit a Data Subject Request](https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/en-us/requests/new?ticket_form_id=25300656511761).

Please also see our [Terms of Service](https://elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use) and [Privacy Policy](https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy) for more information about how we treat your personal data.

# How do I opt out of the sale or sharing of my Personal Data?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/how-do-i-opt-out-of-the-sale-or-sharing-of-my-personal-data.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How do I opt out of the sale or sharing of my Personal Data?

When we share Personal Data through our marketing cookies or with vendors that provide advertising services to us, these disclosures may be considered a sale or sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising, or targeted advertising under certain U.S. state privacy laws. We provide the right to opt-out where there is an applicable law.

If you would like to opt-out, please opt-out through the “Your Privacy Choices” link which can be accessed at the bottom of the website [https://elevenlabs.io/](https://elevenlabs.io/) in jurisdictions that offer this privacy right. Please note that we use cookies to remember your preference and if you clear cookies in your browser, you will need to opt out again. If you do not have an ElevenLabs account or are not logged in to your account, this setting will only apply to the browser you are currently using.

In addition, you have several choices concerning the use of cookies:

* **Browser Settings.** Many web browsers allow you to manage your preferences relating to cookies. You can set your browser to refuse cookies or delete certain cookies. You may be able to manage other technologies in the same way that you manage cookies using your browser's preferences. Please note if you choose to block all cookies, that may have an impact on the functionality of our Services.
* **Google Analytics Opt-out.** To opt-out from Google Analytics' use of information collected on the Services through cookies, you can download the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on, available at [https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).
* **Third Party Advertising Companies' Opt-Out.** We work with third-party advertising partners to show you ads that we think may interest you. Some of our advertising partners are members of the [Network Advertising Initiative](https://optout.networkadvertising.org/?c=1#!/) or the [Digital Advertising Alliance](https://optout.aboutads.info/?c=2\&lang=EN). If you do not wish to receive personalized ads, please visit their opt-out pages to learn about how you may opt out of receiving web-based personalized ads from member companies. You can access any settings offered by your mobile operating system to limit ad tracking, or you can install the AppChoices mobile app to learn more about how you may opt out of personalized ads in mobile apps.

For more information on how we collect, use, and disclose your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy: [https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy](https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy).

# Is my data used to improve ElevenLabs’ AI models?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/is-my-data-used-to-improve-eleven-labs-ai-models.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Is my data used to improve ElevenLabs’ AI models?

ElevenLabs uses certain data you provide to us to improve the quality of our audio models for everyone. We don’t use your data to clone your voice without your consent or create advertising profiles of you.

By default, we don’t train on any data from our Enterprise customers, other than as may be necessary to provide services to such Enterprise customers. Anyone can opt out of data use at any time by following the instructions below.

<strong>
  How can I modify my data use settings?
</strong>

You can modify your data use settings at any time by clicking your profile icon in the top right corner of any page in the ElevenLabs platform and navigating to <strong>Terms and privacy</strong> >  <strong>Data use.</strong>

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/42401306354961" alt="" />

In the <strong>Data use</strong> menu, you’ll see a toggle called <strong>Improve the models for everyone.</strong> To stop sharing your data with us, disable the toggle as shown in the image below and click <strong>Update your choice.</strong> Once the toggle is disabled, new data you submit to us won’t be used to train our models.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/29952698710161" alt="" />

Note that if you previously submitted an opt-out request to us via Typeform, your choice should be reflected in your Data use dialog. For more information, please see our <a href="https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy">Privacy Policy</a>.

# What are No-Go Voices?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/what-are-no-go-voices.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What are No-Go Voices?

In our continuing efforts to ensure a positive experience for all users of our platform, we’re taking specific steps to prevent AI voices from being used to spread misinformation. While our [terms](https://elevenlabs.io/terms) already prohibit using our platform to impersonate or harm others, we are taking the added measure of introducing a “<strong>no-go voices</strong>” safeguard. This safeguard is designed to detect and prevent the creation of specific voice clones. We are working to expand this safeguard to other languages and election cycles. We also aim to continually refine this measure through practical testing and feedback.

 

<strong>
  What is the purpose of the no-go voices policy?
</strong>

* This safeguard restricts the creation of voice clones that approximate the voices of political figures, including those actively involved in presidential elections in the US and UK, as part of our broader commitment to prevent AI voices from being used to fabricate misleading content.

<strong>
  What happens to banned voices?
</strong>

* The voices are blocked and are no longer usable.

<strong>
  What action do you take in misuse cases?
</strong>

* In accordance with our [terms](https://elevenlabs.io/terms) and community rules, we take action as is appropriate based on the violation, which could include warnings, removal of voices, a ban on the account, and, in appropriate cases, cooperating with authorities.

<strong>
  Why don’t you add more voices to the list?
</strong>

* We are currently evaluating additional voices and seek to work with industry partners to extend these safeguards.

 

You can read more about it here:

* [AI Safety](https://elevenlabs.io/safety)

# Can I hear the SynthID watermark?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/can-i-hear-the-synth-id-watermark.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Can I hear the SynthID watermark?

No. The watermark is completely inaudible. SynthID hides a pattern of sound at frequencies that are masked by the existing audio, making it imperceptible to the human ear.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# Does watermarking affect my audio quality or add latency to my generations?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/does-watermarking-affect-my-audio-quality-or-add-latency-to-my-generations.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# Does watermarking affect my audio quality or add latency to my generations?

No on both counts. Our evaluations have found no audible quality degradation, and we carefully engineered our SynthID integration to add zero latency in nearly all cases. You will not notice any change in generation speed or output quality.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# Can the ElevenLabs Audio Detector be used to check audio from other AI platforms?

No. The [ElevenLabs Audio Detector](https://elevenlabs.io/app/audio-detector) can only detect watermarks embedded by ElevenLabs. It will not detect SynthID watermarks applied by other partners such as Google, NVIDIA, or OpenAI.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# Is my audio being watermarked right now?

SynthID watermarking is rolling out in phases. It currently covers all Text to Speech generations by free users and select paid features, and will be expanding to all subscription tiers and all ElevenLabs audio products including Music, Sound Effects, and Dubbing throughout July 2026. If you are unsure whether your specific generations are currently being watermarked, you can check using the [ElevenLabs Audio Detector.](https://elevenlabs.io/app/audio-detector) No ElevenLabs audio created prior to June 2026 carries a SynthID watermark.

# What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?

<a href="https://deepmind.google/models/synthid/">SynthID</a> is Google DeepMind's digital
watermarking technology designed to identify AI-generated content. It embeds imperceptible digital
watermarks directly into AI-generated images, audio, text or video.

ElevenLabs has partnered with Google to embed SynthID watermarks into audio we generate to make it easier for anyone to verify whether a piece of audio originated from our platform. We believe people should know when they are interacting with AI-generated content, and watermarking is one of the most robust ways to provide that transparency.

For more information:

# How can I check whether a piece of audio was generated by ElevenLabs?

Signed-in users can use the free [ElevenLabs Audio Detector.](https://elevenlabs.io/app/audio-detector) To access this tool, open your account profile menu in the top right corner of the website, and select <strong>ElevenLabs Audio Detector</strong>.

Upload an audio file and the tool will tell you whether it contains an ElevenLabs SynthID watermark or has a positive identification from our existing <a href="https://elevenlabs.io/ai-speech-classifier">AI Speech Classifier</a>. For now, Google's SynthID Verification tools (ie. Gemini, Search, Gemini in Chrome) cannot yet detect audio containing ElevenLabs SynthID watermarks.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# What is the difference between the ElevenLabs AI Speech Classifier and the new Audio Detector tool?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-the-difference-between-the-eleven-labs-ai-speech-classifier-and-the-new-audio-detector-tool.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What is the difference between the ElevenLabs AI Speech Classifier and the new Audio Detector tool?

ElevenLabs has two different tools for identifying AI-generated audio, and they work in fundamentally different ways:

* The <a href="https://elevenlabs.io/ai-speech-classifier">AI Speech Classifier</a> is a legacy tool that uses a trained machine learning classifier to predict whether a given audio clip was generated by ElevenLabs. It only works with content generated by older ElevenLabs TTS models.
* The SynthID-based [Audio Detector](https://elevenlabs.io/app/audio-detector) works differently: it scans the audio for a watermark that was cryptographically embedded into it at the time of generation. This makes it significantly more robust and reliable, but because watermarking is new, it can only detect audio generated after watermarking was introduced.

To give users the broadest coverage, we have combined the two into a single [ElevenLabs Audio Detector](https://elevenlabs.io/app/audio-detector) tool, which will check for a SynthID watermark first and fall back to the AI Speech Classifier if no watermark is found. 

You'll need to be signed in to use this tool, but it is available on all plans, including free. To access this tool, open your account profile menu in the top right corner of the website, and select <strong>ElevenLabs Audio Detector</strong>.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# Do you have an affiliate, partnership or educational program?

At ElevenLabs, we’re committed to making a positive impact on society through the power of voice. Our Impact Program partners with nonprofits to provide free licenses, supporting initiatives that drive social good. To find out more and apply, please visit our [Impact Program page.](https://elevenlabs.io/impact-program)

We're working in partnership with Bridging Voice, The Scott-Morgan Foundation and other organizations to help people who are losing their voice due to medical conditions such as ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis) or MND (Motor Neurone Disease). If you or a loved one could benefit from this, please visit our [Impact Program page](https://elevenlabs.io/impact-program) to learn more and apply.

ElevenLabs operates an Affiliate program. To find out more, please see our [Affiliates page](https://elevenlabs.io/affiliates). To get started, create an account and log in. Click your profile icon in the top right corner of the website to open your account menu, then select <strong>Affiliate program</strong>.

# Will SynthID watermarks cause my content to be flagged, downranked, or demonetized on YouTube or other platforms?

No other platforms can currently detect ElevenLabs watermarks. Our SynthID partnership is focused on public AI transparency — giving people the ability to verify whether audio is AI-generated — and is not connected to other platforms’ monetization or content policies.

For more information, see [What is SynthID, and why is ElevenLabs using it?](/docs/help-center/legal/audio-detector/what-is-synth-id-and-why-is-eleven-labs-using-it)

# I'm an Affiliate with lots of sign-ups, why haven't I been paid yet?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/partnerships/im-an-affiliate-with-lots-of-sign-ups-why-havent-i-been-paid-yet.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# I'm an Affiliate with lots of sign-ups, why haven't I been paid yet?

You are rewarded for every paid signup through your referral link.

Once someone signs up for a paid subscription, the respective commission fee we owe you becomes active <strong>90 days later</strong>. This is due to our customers' credit card dispute rights. - we want to avoid unnecessary refunds.

Once that period is over, the respective amount in 'Revenue' will then turn to 'Pending'.  There is a minimum payment threshold of \$5, but once you've crossed that threshold, you will be paid the pending amount in the next payment period, which is between the 1st and 15th of each month.

Some funds may be held due to suspicious activity that is automatically flagged by our system - this may take some time to resolve as it is investigated manually.

For more information, please refer to your Partner Guidebook, which can be found by clicking the Resources Tab in your [Partnerstack Dashboard.](https://dash.partnerstack.com/home)

# How can I make sure my microphone is working?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/troubleshooting/how-can-i-make-sure-my-microphone-is-working.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# How can I make sure my microphone is working?

If you're using Chrome on Windows, please try these steps to make sure your microphone is working correctly on ElevenLabs.

1. In Windows Privacy and Security menu, select Microphone Privacy Settings, then enable Microphone access.

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/29040322052497" alt="" />

2. In Chrome, reset the permissions and set them again to make sure that the website has permission to use the microphone.  Click the arrow next to Microphone, then click the toggle to enable it, and select 'Allow on every visit'.  Make sure it says 'Allowed'. 

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/29040322055313" alt="" />

   

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/29040322056081" alt="" />

 

3. In Chrome, go to chrome://settings/content/microphone or select 'Settings' in your menu, then select 'Privacy and security', then under 'Permissions', select 'Microphone'.  Make sure that the correct microphone is selected in the menu.

4. You can test that your microphone is working by using [Voice Changer](https://elevenlabs.io/app/speech-synthesis/speech-to-speech). 

<img src="https://help.elevenlabs.io/hc/article_attachments/29040322057361" alt="" />

Click 'Record Audio', then click the microphone icon to begin recording.  Record a quick test, then press the stop icon to stop recording.  You can then play back your recording to check that the microphone is working correctly.  You will not be charged unless you click 'Generate speech'.

# What are some issues I might encounter and how can I avoid them?

**URL:** https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/troubleshooting/what-are-some-issues-i-might-encounter-and-how-can-i-avoid-them.md

> This is a page from the ElevenLabs documentation. For a complete page index, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms.txt. For the full documentation in a single file, fetch https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt.

# What are some issues I might encounter and how can I avoid them?

AI is a highly advanced field of technology and can, at times, be unpredictable as the output is based on the input and then interpreted by the AI. We have tried to minimize the unpredictability as much as possible and keep adding features and improvements that make it more predictable and controllable. However, there are still a few things you need to be mindful of, and this applies to all generative AI.

You can read more in our [guide to troubleshooting.](/docs/creative-platform/troubleshooting)

<strong>Multilingual v2 Model</strong>: This model represents a significant improvement in
predictability and consistency compared to the experimental multilingual v1 model. It has resolved
many of the issues associated with the v1 model, although some minor issues still exist, such as
inconsistency and language switching.

<strong>Inconsistency</strong>: Users have reported occasional inconsistencies between AI
generations, where the output does not fit together perfectly. This issue is being worked on and
is less prominent in the multilingual v2 model. Cloning the voice with consistent samples is
recommended to address this.

<strong>Language Switching</strong>: A common problem is the AI switching languages or accents
within a single generation, especially in longer texts. This issue is being addressed, but using
a [properly cloned voice](/docs/voices/voice-lab/instant-voice-cloning) with the Projects
feature can help mitigate it.

<strong>Corrupt Speech</strong>: A rare issue where the AI produces muffled and strange-sounding
speech. There are no specific solutions, but regenerating the section usually resolves it.

<strong>Studio (previously Projects)</strong>: Studio is a workflow for creating long-form content
using AI. It generally works well with a proper voice choice and model.

<strong>Import Function</strong>: The import function attempts to import files, but due to the
number of formatting variables, users should double-check imported content for accuracy. Some
issues may require manual adjustments.

<strong>Glitches between Paragraphs</strong>: Occasionally, glitches or abrupt transitions
between paragraphs may happen. This issue is rare and is being actively worked on. Regenerating
the last paragraph can often resolve it.

<strong>Multilingual v1 (Experimental)</strong>: This experimental model may exhibit tone and
quality issues across longer segments, introduce noise, and have transitions between male and female
voices. It is less stable for longer generations compared to the monolingual model and is
recommended for shorter texts in English.

<strong>Factors Affecting Issues</strong>: Several factors affect AI performance, including text
chunk length, monolingual vs. multilingual models, voice type (pre-made, voice-designed, or
cloned), and settings like stability and similarity.

<strong>Future Developments</strong>: The team is actively working on improving AI performance
and developing new technologies like the Projects feature.

Here are a few issues you might encounter: audio corruption, audio degradation, whispering, volume fluctuation, inconsistency, language switching, glitches, and a few. They are generally very rare and voice-dependent.

We support a range of audio formats across our website and via API.
